description: This is a PHP test class for the EmployeeLanguageDao in the OrangeHRM project. It contains unit tests for CRUD operations, search, and permission-related methods of EmployeeLanguageDao, using the PHPUnit framework.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguageDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing EmployeeLanguageDao functionalities such as saving, retrieving, searching, counting, deleting, and permission checks related to employee languages in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, instantiates EmployeeLanguageDao, and populates test data fixtures.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeLanguage
methods.description: Tests saving a new employee language entity and verifying it persists correctly.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeLanguage
methods.description: Tests retrieving a specific employee language by employee ID, language ID, and fluency, including null cases.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeLanguages
methods.description: Tests searching for employee languages with various filter parameters and verifies results.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeLanguagesCount
methods.description: Tests counting employee languages based on search filters.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeLanguagesWithLanguageIds
methods.description: Tests filtering employee languages by specific language IDs.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeLanguages
methods.description: Tests deletion of employee language entries based on provided identifiers.

methods.name: testGetAllowedEmployeeLanguages
methods.description: Tests retrieval of allowed languages for an employee based on permission filters.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeAllowedLicensesCount
methods.description: Tests counting of allowed employee languages for permission purposes.
